voice.steering: Speak in a quiet, tense, investigative true-crime narrator voice.

world_anchor: True crime investigative journalism archive, cold case files
style_block: Cinematic crime documentary photography, moody high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, deep shadow tones, desaturated color palette, subtle lens grain.
negative_block: No cartoon elements, no exaggerated gore, no bright tropical colors, no text, no watermark, no signature, no logo.

evidence_photo.prompt: Flash-lit evidence photograph, flat frontal light, scale marker, clinical framing.

surveillance_still.prompt: Grainy surveillance still, low resolution, high-contrast monochrome.

newspaper_archive.prompt: Clipped newspaper archive fragments layered on a case file folder.

courtroom_sketch.prompt: Courtroom sketch in coloured pencil and pastel, loose confident line.

night_exterior.prompt: Figure silhouetted under a sodium streetlight on a wet night street.
